text:
maya: Pushed a docs PR for the upcoming release, please review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212. Highlights in the draft: routing policy defaults, embeddings streaming deprecation note, Dedicated autoscale examples. Need eyes on known issues and SDK snippet parity before I merge.

tom: On it. Quick question — did we already update the JS SDK examples for the streaming change? I thought the param name switched from `stream` to `streaming` in the new client.

maya: I updated Go and Python snippets. JS is still TODO and marked in the PR with `SNIPPET_JS_PENDING`. Example I changed for py/go is small, e.g.:
```py
resp = client.chat.create(model='kitefish', stream=True)
```

liam: I can take the JS bits. Proposed JS snippet to replace: 
```js
const resp = await client.chat.create({ model: 'kitefish', streaming: true })
for await (const chunk of resp) { console.log(chunk) }
```
That follows the new streaming iterator pattern.

sara: ran link-checker on the branch — two anchors failing: `/docs/models#kv-cache` -> should redirect to `/reference/kv-cache`. I'll add a redirect rule in the site config, pushing a tiny commit to the PR branch. Also found one stale external link to an old benchmark blog; marked it with TODO.

docs-bot: link-checker report: 2 broken anchors found, 1 external warning. Full output: https://ci.internal/reports/linkcheck/4212

kevin: For the changelog blurb about routing fallback, suggest clarifying: "Default routing policy for hosted tier now favors latency over cost; customers can opt back to cost-first via policy override. Failover behavior: if faster model is unavailable, system falls back to the cost-optimized variant — calls are not dropped." Might be worth adding a config snippet: 
```yaml
routing_policy:
  preference: latency
  fallback: cost_variant
```

maya: Good wording, Kevin — can you add that exact paragraph to the release note section? @sara thanks for the redirect. @liam please paste the JS snippet as a PR commit; if you add a one-line note about the param rename that helps docs readers. Updated checklist in the PR description: [x] go examples, [x] py examples, [ ] js examples, [x] redirects (PR pending), [x] known issues drafted. Plan: merge after JS + redirect. Target merge window 16:00 PST today.

tom: :thumbsup: If anyone wants to run a quick visual QA on the deploy preview after those commits, ping me.

docs-bot: deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-4212--docs.redwood.ai/ (preview expires in 7 days)

maya: Thanks all — I'll hold the merge until we have the JS commit and the redirect. If both land before 15:45 PST I'll merge and tag the release notes for publication.

liam: Pushed JS snippet and short note in PR, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212/files#diff-... . Marked JS as done.

sara: Redirect commit pushed + updated site config. Ran `npm run link-check` locally — all green now.

maya: Perfect. Merging in ~5m. Will post a short announce blurb once live.
